```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = "hide")

input_file <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
has_input_file <- !is.null(input_file) &&
  length(input_file) > 0 &&
  !is.na(input_file) &&
  nzchar(input_file)

if (has_input_file) {
  input_dir <- dirname(normalizePath(input_file, mustWork = FALSE))
  project_dir <- if (basename(input_dir) == "code") {
    normalizePath(file.path(input_dir, ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
  } else {
    normalizePath(input_dir, mustWork = TRUE)
  }
} else {
  cwd <- normalizePath(getwd(), mustWork = TRUE)
  project_dir <- if (basename(cwd) == "code") {
    normalizePath(file.path(cwd, ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
  } else {
    cwd
  }
}

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_dir)
setwd(project_dir)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tximport)
  library(DESeq2)
  library(WGCNA)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(Mfuzz)
  library(Biobase)
  library(scales)
  library(igraph)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(jsonlite)
})


options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
WGCNA::allowWGCNAThreads()

rdata_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "RData")
dir.create(rdata_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

rds_file <- function(name) {
  file.path(rdata_dir, paste0(name, ".rds"))
}

cache_or_run <- function(name, expr, refresh = FALSE) {
  path <- rds_file(name)
  if (file.exists(path) && !refresh) {
    message("Loading cached object: ", path)
    readRDS(path)
  } else {
    message("Running and saving object: ", path)
    value <- force(expr)
    saveRDS(value, path)
    value
  }
}

load_rds_object <- function(name, required = TRUE) {
  path <- rds_file(name)
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    if (required) stop("Missing cached object: ", path)
    return(NULL)
  }
  readRDS(path)
}

load_rds_list <- function(name, required = TRUE, envir = .GlobalEnv) {
  value <- load_rds_object(name, required = required)
  if (!is.null(value)) list2env(value, envir = envir)
  invisible(value)
}

analysis_file <- function(...) {
  file.path(rdata_dir, ...)
}

input_file_path <- function(...) {
  cached <- file.path(rdata_dir, ...)
  if (file.exists(cached)) return(cached)
  file.path(project_dir, ...)
}

show_table <- function(x, n = 20, title = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(title)) {
    cat("\n### ", title, "\n\n", sep = "")
  }
  if (is.null(x)) {
    cat("No object available.\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  df <- as.data.frame(x)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    cat("No rows.\n")
    return(invisible(df))
  }
  print(utils::head(df, n))
  invisible(df)
}

show_plot_files <- function(paths) {
  paths <- paths[file.exists(paths)]
  if (length(paths) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  paths <- normalizePath(paths, mustWork = TRUE)
  knitr::include_graphics(paths)
}
```

```{r load-upstream}
load_rds_list("01_deseq_lrt")
```

```{r}

############################################################
## Step 3. log2FC threshold sensitivity analysis
## Purpose:
##   Use LRT padj < 0.05 as the primary criterion,
##   and evaluate how many biologically relevant NLRs would be lost
##   under strict |log2FC| >= 1 filtering.
##
## Main input:
##   1. dds or dds_lrt
##   2. res, DESeq2 LRT result, optional if master table already has padj
##   3. NLR_master_TNL_CNL_RNL.tsv
##
## Main output:
##   Directory: log2FC_threshold_sensitivity_TNL_CNL_RNL
############################################################


## -----------------------------
## 0. Settings
## -----------------------------

outdir <- analysis_file("log2FC_threshold_sensitivity_TNL_CNL_RNL")
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

tcr_levels <- c("TNL", "CNL", "RNL")

alpha_lrt <- 0.05
alpha_wald <- 0.05

thresholds <- c(1, 0.75, 0.5, 0.25, 0)

time_col <- "time"

manual_control_level <- NULL
# manual_control_level <- "CK"

manual_target_levels <- NULL
# manual_target_levels <- c("2d", "5d", "8d")


## -----------------------------
## 1. Helper functions
## -----------------------------

save_plot <- function(plot_obj, filename, width = 7, height = 5) {
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(outdir, paste0(filename, ".pdf")),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height
  )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(outdir, paste0(filename, ".png")),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = 300
  )
}

as_logical_safe <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) return(x)
  
  x_chr <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  
  dplyr::case_when(
    x_chr %in% c("TRUE", "T", "1", "YES", "Y") ~ TRUE,
    x_chr %in% c("FALSE", "F", "0", "NO", "N") ~ FALSE,
    TRUE ~ NA
  )
}

make_suffix <- function(x) {
  y <- stringr::str_replace_all(x, "[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_")
  y <- stringr::str_replace_all(y, "^_+|_+$", "")
  y[y == ""] <- "time"
  make.unique(y, sep = "_")
}

extract_day <- function(x) {
  day_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(stringr::str_extract(x, "\\d+\\.?\\d*")))
  day_num[is.na(day_num)] <- Inf
  day_num
}

threshold_label_fun <- function(th) {
  ifelse(
    th == 0,
    "LRT only",
    paste0("|max log2FC| >= ", th)
  )
}

type_cols <- c(
  TNL = "#7B3294",
  CNL = "#008837",
  RNL = "#E66101"
)

strength_cols <- c(
  "strong_|LFC|>=1" = "#B2182B",
  "moderate_0.5<=|LFC|<1" = "#EF8A62",
  "subtle_0.25<=|LFC|<0.5" = "#FDDDBC",
  "LRT_only_|LFC|<0.25" = "#D1E5F0",
  "LRT_DE_no_LFC" = "#BDBDBD"
)


## -----------------------------
## 2. Check DESeq2 object
## -----------------------------

if (!exists("dds") && exists("dds_lrt")) {
  dds <- dds_lrt
  message("Object 'dds' was not found. Using 'dds_lrt' as dds.")
}

if (!exists("dds")) {
  stop("Cannot find object 'dds' or 'dds_lrt'. Please load your DESeqDataSet first.")
}


## -----------------------------
## 3. Detect time column and time levels
## -----------------------------

sample_info <- as.data.frame(colData(dds))

if (!time_col %in% colnames(sample_info)) {
  candidate_time_cols <- c(
    "time", "Time",
    "day", "Day",
    "condition", "Condition",
    "group", "Group",
    "treatment", "Treatment"
  )
  
  matched_time_col <- intersect(candidate_time_cols, colnames(sample_info))
  
  if (length(matched_time_col) == 0) {
    stop(
      "Cannot identify time column in colData(dds). Available columns are: ",
      paste(colnames(sample_info), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  
  time_col <- matched_time_col[1]
  message("Using detected time column: ", time_col)
}

time_vector <- sample_info[[time_col]]

if (is.factor(time_vector)) {
  time_levels <- levels(time_vector)
} else {
  time_levels <- unique(as.character(time_vector))
}

time_levels <- time_levels[!is.na(time_levels)]

cat("\nDetected time column:", time_col, "\n")
cat("Detected time levels:", paste(time_levels, collapse = ", "), "\n")


## -----------------------------
## 4. Detect control and treatment time points
## -----------------------------

if (is.null(manual_control_level)) {
  control_candidates <- c(
    "0d", "0D", "d0", "D0",
    "0day", "0Day", "day0", "Day0",
    "0dpi", "0DPI",
    "CK", "ck",
    "control", "Control", "CTRL", "ctrl",
    "CON", "con",
    "0"
  )
  
  control_hits <- time_levels[tolower(time_levels) %in% tolower(control_candidates)]
  
  if (length(control_hits) == 0) {
    stop(
      "Cannot automatically identify control level. Please set manual_control_level. Available time levels are: ",
      paste(time_levels, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  
  control_level <- control_hits[1]
} else {
  control_level <- manual_control_level
}

if (!control_level %in% time_levels) {
  stop(
    "control_level is not found in time levels. control_level = ",
    control_level,
    "; available levels = ",
    paste(time_levels, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (is.null(manual_target_levels)) {
  target_levels <- setdiff(time_levels, control_level)
  target_levels <- target_levels[order(extract_day(target_levels), target_levels)]
} else {
  target_levels <- manual_target_levels
}

if (!all(target_levels %in% time_levels)) {
  stop(
    "Some target levels are not found in time levels. target_levels = ",
    paste(target_levels, collapse = ", "),
    "; available levels = ",
    paste(time_levels, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

cat("Control level:", control_level, "\n")
cat("Target levels:", paste(target_levels, collapse = ", "), "\n")

time_suffixes <- make_suffix(target_levels)

time_info <- tibble(
  time_level = target_levels,
  suffix = time_suffixes,
  contrast = paste0(target_levels, "_vs_", control_level)
)

write_tsv(
  time_info,
  file.path(outdir, "Wald_contrast_time_info.tsv")
)

print(time_info)


## -----------------------------
## 5. Run DESeq2 Wald test
## -----------------------------

dds_wald <- dds

new_time_levels <- c(control_level, target_levels, setdiff(time_levels, c(control_level, target_levels)))

colData(dds_wald)[[time_col]] <- factor(
  as.character(colData(dds_wald)[[time_col]]),
  levels = new_time_levels
)

colData(dds_wald)[[time_col]] <- relevel(
  colData(dds_wald)[[time_col]],
  ref = control_level
)

cat("\nRunning DESeq2 Wald test...\n")
dds_wald <- cache_or_run("10_deseq_wald", {
  DESeq(dds_wald, test = "Wald")
})

cat("\nAvailable results names:\n")
print(resultsNames(dds_wald))


## -----------------------------
## 6. Extract Wald pairwise results
## -----------------------------

extract_wald_result <- function(tp, suf) {
  
  cat("Extracting Wald contrast:", tp, "vs", control_level, "\n")
  
  res_tp <- results(
    dds_wald,
    contrast = c(time_col, tp, control_level),
    alpha = alpha_wald
  )
  
  as.data.frame(res_tp) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
    mutate(Gene = as.character(Gene) %>% str_trim()) %>%
    transmute(
      Gene,
      !!paste0("baseMean_Wald_", suf) := as.numeric(baseMean),
      !!paste0("log2FC_", suf) := as.numeric(log2FoldChange),
      !!paste0("lfcSE_", suf) := as.numeric(lfcSE),
      !!paste0("stat_Wald_", suf) := as.numeric(stat),
      !!paste0("pvalue_Wald_", suf) := as.numeric(pvalue),
      !!paste0("padj_Wald_", suf) := as.numeric(padj)
    )
}

wald_result_list <- map2(
  target_levels,
  time_suffixes,
  extract_wald_result
)

wald_all <- purrr::reduce(
  wald_result_list,
  dplyr::full_join,
  by = "Gene"
)

write_tsv(
  wald_all,
  file.path(outdir, "All_genes_Wald_pairwise_results.tsv")
)


## -----------------------------
## 7. Read TNL/CNL/RNL master table
## -----------------------------

if (file.exists(analysis_file("NLR_master_TNL_CNL_RNL.tsv"))) {
  nlr_master <- read_tsv(
    analysis_file("NLR_master_TNL_CNL_RNL.tsv"),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
} else if (exists("nlr_master")) {
  nlr_master <- as_tibble(nlr_master)
  message("Using object 'nlr_master' from current R environment.")
} else {
  stop("Cannot find NLR_master_TNL_CNL_RNL.tsv or object 'nlr_master'.")
}

if (!"Gene" %in% colnames(nlr_master)) {
  colnames(nlr_master)[1] <- "Gene"
}

nlr_master <- nlr_master %>%
  mutate(
    Gene = as.character(Gene) %>% str_trim(),
    Type = as.character(Type) %>% str_trim() %>% str_to_upper()
  ) %>%
  filter(Type %in% tcr_levels)

if (!"padj" %in% colnames(nlr_master)) {
  
  if (!exists("res")) {
    stop("NLR master table does not contain LRT padj, and object 'res' was not found.")
  }
  
  res_lrt <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
    mutate(Gene = as.character(Gene) %>% str_trim()) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene, baseMean, stat, pvalue, padj)
  
  nlr_master <- nlr_master %>%
    left_join(res_lrt, by = "Gene")
}

nlr_master <- nlr_master %>%
  mutate(
    Type = factor(Type, levels = tcr_levels),
    Has_padj = !is.na(padj),
    DE_LRT = case_when(
      Has_padj & padj < alpha_lrt ~ TRUE,
      Has_padj & padj >= alpha_lrt ~ FALSE,
      TRUE ~ NA
    )
  )

cat("\n===== NLR master check =====\n")
print(
  nlr_master %>%
    group_by(Type) %>%
    summarise(
      Total_NLR = n(),
      Tested_NLR = sum(Has_padj),
      LRT_DE_NLR = sum(DE_LRT == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
)


## -----------------------------
## 8. Merge Wald log2FC into NLR master
## -----------------------------

nlr_lfc <- nlr_master %>%
  left_join(wald_all, by = "Gene")

lfc_cols <- paste0("log2FC_", time_suffixes)
padj_wald_cols <- paste0("padj_Wald_", time_suffixes)

missing_lfc_cols <- setdiff(lfc_cols, colnames(nlr_lfc))
missing_padj_cols <- setdiff(padj_wald_cols, colnames(nlr_lfc))

if (length(missing_lfc_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Missing log2FC columns: ", paste(missing_lfc_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

if (length(missing_padj_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Missing Wald padj columns: ", paste(missing_padj_cols, collapse = ", "))
}


## -----------------------------
## 9. Calculate max_abs_log2FC across time points
## -----------------------------

lfc_mat <- nlr_lfc %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(lfc_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
  as.matrix()

padj_wald_mat <- nlr_lfc %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(padj_wald_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
  as.matrix()

max_abs_log2FC <- apply(
  lfc_mat,
  1,
  function(x) {
    if (all(is.na(x))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      max(abs(x), na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }
)

abs_lfc_for_idx <- abs(lfc_mat)
abs_lfc_for_idx[is.na(abs_lfc_for_idx)] <- -Inf

valid_lfc <- rowSums(!is.na(lfc_mat)) > 0
max_idx <- max.col(abs_lfc_for_idx, ties.method = "first")

log2FC_at_max <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(lfc_mat))
main_response_time <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(lfc_mat))

log2FC_at_max[valid_lfc] <- lfc_mat[cbind(which(valid_lfc), max_idx[valid_lfc])]
main_response_time[valid_lfc] <- target_levels[max_idx[valid_lfc]]

any_Wald_padj05 <- rowSums(padj_wald_mat < alpha_wald, na.rm = TRUE) > 0

Wald_sig_timepoints <- apply(
  padj_wald_mat,
  1,
  function(x) {
    sig <- !is.na(x) & x < alpha_wald
    if (any(sig)) {
      paste(target_levels[sig], collapse = ";")
    } else {
      NA_character_
    }
  }
)

nlr_lfc <- nlr_lfc %>%
  mutate(
    max_abs_log2FC = max_abs_log2FC,
    log2FC_at_max = log2FC_at_max,
    main_response_time = main_response_time,
    direction_at_max = case_when(
      log2FC_at_max > 0 ~ "up_at_max",
      log2FC_at_max < 0 ~ "down_at_max",
      log2FC_at_max == 0 ~ "zero_at_max",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    any_Wald_padj05 = any_Wald_padj05,
    Wald_sig_timepoints = Wald_sig_timepoints,
    response_strength = case_when(
      is.na(DE_LRT) | DE_LRT == FALSE ~ "not_LRT_DE",
      DE_LRT == TRUE & is.na(max_abs_log2FC) ~ "LRT_DE_no_LFC",
      DE_LRT == TRUE & max_abs_log2FC >= 1 ~ "strong_|LFC|>=1",
      DE_LRT == TRUE & max_abs_log2FC >= 0.5 ~ "moderate_0.5<=|LFC|<1",
      DE_LRT == TRUE & max_abs_log2FC >= 0.25 ~ "subtle_0.25<=|LFC|<0.5",
      DE_LRT == TRUE ~ "LRT_only_|LFC|<0.25",
      TRUE ~ "not_LRT_DE"
    )
  )

response_strength_levels <- c(
  "strong_|LFC|>=1",
  "moderate_0.5<=|LFC|<1",
  "subtle_0.25<=|LFC|<0.5",
  "LRT_only_|LFC|<0.25",
  "LRT_DE_no_LFC",
  "not_LRT_DE"
)

nlr_lfc <- nlr_lfc %>%
  mutate(
    response_strength = factor(
      response_strength,
      levels = response_strength_levels
    )
  )

write_tsv(
  nlr_lfc,
  file.path(outdir, "NLR_TCR_LRT_Wald_log2FC_sensitivity.tsv")
)


## -----------------------------
## 10. Threshold sensitivity by Type
## -----------------------------

threshold_by_type <- map_dfr(
  thresholds,
  function(th) {
    
    df <- nlr_lfc %>%
      filter(Has_padj)
    
    if (th == 0) {
      df <- df %>%
        mutate(pass_threshold = DE_LRT == TRUE)
    } else {
      df <- df %>%
        mutate(
          pass_threshold = DE_LRT == TRUE &
            !is.na(max_abs_log2FC) &
            max_abs_log2FC >= th
        )
    }
    
    df %>%
      group_by(Type) %>%
      summarise(
        Tested_NLR = n(),
        LRT_DE_NLR = sum(DE_LRT == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
        Retained_NLR = sum(pass_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
        Lost_NLR = LRT_DE_NLR - Retained_NLR,
        Retained_ratio_of_LRT_DE = ifelse(
          LRT_DE_NLR > 0,
          Retained_NLR / LRT_DE_NLR,
          NA_real_
        ),
        Lost_ratio_of_LRT_DE = ifelse(
          LRT_DE_NLR > 0,
          Lost_NLR / LRT_DE_NLR,
          NA_real_
        ),
        Retained_ratio_of_tested = Retained_NLR / Tested_NLR,
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        threshold = th,
        threshold_label = threshold_label_fun(th)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        threshold,
        threshold_label,
        Type,
        Tested_NLR,
        LRT_DE_NLR,
        Retained_NLR,
        Lost_NLR,
        Retained_ratio_of_LRT_DE,
        Lost_ratio_of_LRT_DE,
        Retained_ratio_of_tested
      )
  }
)

threshold_by_type <- threshold_by_type %>%
  mutate(
    threshold_label = factor(
      threshold_label,
      levels = threshold_label_fun(thresholds)
    ),
    Type = factor(Type, levels = tcr_levels)
  ) %>%
  arrange(threshold, Type)

write_tsv(
  threshold_by_type,
  file.path(outdir, "NLR_TCR_threshold_sensitivity_by_type.tsv")
)

cat("\n===== Threshold sensitivity by type =====\n")
print(threshold_by_type)


## -----------------------------
## 11. Threshold sensitivity overall
## -----------------------------

threshold_overall <- threshold_by_type %>%
  group_by(threshold, threshold_label) %>%
  summarise(
    Tested_NLR = sum(Tested_NLR),
    LRT_DE_NLR = sum(LRT_DE_NLR),
    Retained_NLR = sum(Retained_NLR),
    Lost_NLR = sum(Lost_NLR),
    Retained_ratio_of_LRT_DE = ifelse(
      LRT_DE_NLR > 0,
      Retained_NLR / LRT_DE_NLR,
      NA_real_
    ),
    Lost_ratio_of_LRT_DE = ifelse(
      LRT_DE_NLR > 0,
      Lost_NLR / LRT_DE_NLR,
      NA_real_
    ),
    Retained_ratio_of_tested = Retained_NLR / Tested_NLR,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(threshold)

write_tsv(
  threshold_overall,
  file.path(outdir, "NLR_TCR_threshold_sensitivity_overall.tsv")
)

cat("\n===== Threshold sensitivity overall =====\n")
print(threshold_overall)


## -----------------------------
## 12. Strict |log2FC| >= 1 loss summary
## -----------------------------

strict_loss_summary <- threshold_by_type %>%
  filter(threshold == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    Interpretation = paste0(
      "Using strict |max log2FC| >= 1 would retain ",
      Retained_NLR,
      " of ",
      LRT_DE_NLR,
      " LRT-DE ",
      as.character(Type),
      " genes and lose ",
      Lost_NLR,
      " genes."
    )
  )

write_tsv(
  strict_loss_summary,
  file.path(outdir, "NLR_TCR_strict_log2FC1_loss_summary.tsv")
)

cat("\n===== Strict |log2FC| >= 1 loss summary =====\n")
print(strict_loss_summary)


## -----------------------------
## 13. Response strength summary
## -----------------------------

response_strength_summary <- nlr_lfc %>%
  filter(DE_LRT == TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    Type = factor(Type, levels = tcr_levels),
    response_strength = factor(
      as.character(response_strength),
      levels = response_strength_levels[response_strength_levels != "not_LRT_DE"]
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(Type, response_strength, name = "NLR_count") %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    Type = factor(tcr_levels, levels = tcr_levels),
    response_strength = factor(
      response_strength_levels[response_strength_levels != "not_LRT_DE"],
      levels = response_strength_levels[response_strength_levels != "not_LRT_DE"]
    ),
    fill = list(NLR_count = 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Type) %>%
  mutate(
    Type_total_DE = sum(NLR_count),
    Within_type_ratio = ifelse(
      Type_total_DE > 0,
      NLR_count / Type_total_DE,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

write_tsv(
  response_strength_summary,
  file.path(outdir, "NLR_TCR_response_strength_summary.tsv")
)

cat("\n===== Response strength summary =====\n")
print(response_strength_summary)


## -----------------------------
## 14. Main response time and direction
## -----------------------------

main_time_direction_summary <- nlr_lfc %>%
  filter(DE_LRT == TRUE, !is.na(main_response_time), !is.na(direction_at_max)) %>%
  mutate(
    Type = factor(Type, levels = tcr_levels),
    main_response_time = factor(main_response_time, levels = target_levels),
    direction_at_max = factor(
      direction_at_max,
      levels = c("up_at_max", "down_at_max", "zero_at_max")
    ),
    response_time_direction = paste(main_response_time, direction_at_max, sep = "_")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(
    Type,
    main_response_time,
    direction_at_max,
    response_time_direction,
    name = "NLR_count"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Type) %>%
  mutate(
    Type_total_DE = sum(NLR_count),
    Within_type_ratio = NLR_count / Type_total_DE
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

write_tsv(
  main_time_direction_summary,
  file.path(outdir, "NLR_TCR_main_response_time_direction_summary.tsv")
)

cat("\n===== Main response time and direction =====\n")
print(main_time_direction_summary)


## -----------------------------
## 15. Per-timepoint threshold sensitivity
## -----------------------------

per_time_threshold_by_type <- map2_dfr(
  target_levels,
  time_suffixes,
  function(tp, suf) {
    
    lfc_col <- paste0("log2FC_", suf)
    padj_col <- paste0("padj_Wald_", suf)
    
    map_dfr(
      thresholds,
      function(th) {
        
        nlr_lfc %>%
          filter(Has_padj) %>%
          mutate(
            abs_fc_pass = ifelse(
              th == 0,
              TRUE,
              !is.na(.data[[lfc_col]]) & abs(.data[[lfc_col]]) >= th
            ),
            LRT_DE_pass_threshold = DE_LRT == TRUE & abs_fc_pass,
            Wald_DE_pass_threshold = !is.na(.data[[padj_col]]) &
              .data[[padj_col]] < alpha_wald &
              abs_fc_pass,
            Up_LRT_DE_pass_threshold = DE_LRT == TRUE &
              !is.na(.data[[lfc_col]]) &
              .data[[lfc_col]] > 0 &
              abs_fc_pass,
            Down_LRT_DE_pass_threshold = DE_LRT == TRUE &
              !is.na(.data[[lfc_col]]) &
              .data[[lfc_col]] < 0 &
              abs_fc_pass
          ) %>%
          group_by(Type) %>%
          summarise(
            Tested_NLR = n(),
            LRT_DE_NLR = sum(DE_LRT == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
            LRT_DE_pass_threshold = sum(LRT_DE_pass_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
            Wald_DE_pass_threshold = sum(Wald_DE_pass_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
            Up_LRT_DE_pass_threshold = sum(Up_LRT_DE_pass_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
            Down_LRT_DE_pass_threshold = sum(Down_LRT_DE_pass_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop"
          ) %>%
          mutate(
            time_point = tp,
            threshold = th,
            threshold_label = threshold_label_fun(th)
          ) %>%
          dplyr::select(
            time_point,
            threshold,
            threshold_label,
            Type,
            Tested_NLR,
            LRT_DE_NLR,
            LRT_DE_pass_threshold,
            Wald_DE_pass_threshold,
            Up_LRT_DE_pass_threshold,
            Down_LRT_DE_pass_threshold
          )
      }
    )
  }
)

per_time_threshold_by_type <- per_time_threshold_by_type %>%
  mutate(
    time_point = factor(time_point, levels = target_levels),
    threshold_label = factor(threshold_label, levels = threshold_label_fun(thresholds)),
    Type = factor(Type, levels = tcr_levels)
  )

write_tsv(
  per_time_threshold_by_type,
  file.path(outdir, "NLR_TCR_per_timepoint_threshold_sensitivity_by_type.tsv")
)


## -----------------------------
## 16. Fisher test:
##     Does structural type affect passing each FC threshold
##     among LRT-DE NLRs?
## -----------------------------

threshold_fisher <- map_dfr(
  thresholds[thresholds > 0],
  function(th) {
    
    threshold_df <- nlr_lfc %>%
      filter(Has_padj, DE_LRT == TRUE) %>%
      mutate(
        Type = factor(Type, levels = tcr_levels),
        Pass_threshold = !is.na(max_abs_log2FC) & max_abs_log2FC >= th
      ) %>%
      dplyr::count(Type, Pass_threshold, name = "n") %>%
      tidyr::complete(
        Type = factor(tcr_levels, levels = tcr_levels),
        Pass_threshold = c(FALSE, TRUE),
        fill = list(n = 0)
      )
    
    threshold_mat <- threshold_df %>%
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = Pass_threshold,
        values_from = n,
        values_fill = 0
      ) %>%
      arrange(Type)
    
    mat <- threshold_mat %>%
      dplyr::select(`FALSE`, `TRUE`) %>%
      as.matrix()
    
    rownames(mat) <- as.character(threshold_mat$Type)
    
    ft <- fisher.test(mat)
    
    tibble(
      threshold = th,
      threshold_label = threshold_label_fun(th),
      pvalue = ft$p.value
    )
  }
) %>%
  mutate(
    padj_BH = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "BH")
  )

write_tsv(
  threshold_fisher,
  file.path(outdir, "Fisher_test_Type_vs_passing_log2FC_threshold_among_LRT_DE.tsv")
)

capture.output(
  threshold_fisher,
  file = file.path(outdir, "Fisher_test_Type_vs_passing_log2FC_threshold_among_LRT_DE.txt")
)

cat("\n===== Fisher test: Type vs passing FC threshold among LRT-DE NLRs =====\n")
print(threshold_fisher)

strict_loss_plot_df <- strict_loss_summary %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%

  transmute(
    Type = factor(as.character(Type), levels = tcr_levels),
    Retained = Retained_NLR,
    Lost = Lost_NLR
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("Retained", "Lost"),
    names_to = "Status",
    values_to = "NLR_count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Status = factor(Status, levels = c("Retained", "Lost"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(Type) %>%
  mutate(
    Type_total = sum(NLR_count),
    Ratio = ifelse(Type_total > 0, NLR_count / Type_total, NA_real_),
    label = ifelse(NLR_count > 0, as.character(NLR_count), "")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```
